name: Bretagard
description: Bretagard is the human realm of Kaldheim, home of the Skelle clan, where the final battle of the Kaldheim story is fought.

bio.text: Bretagard is described as the realm of Kaldheim where the events occur, the realm where Jutmaw lies, the realm Kaya came from, and where Niko joined the Kannah.

bio.text: In The Battle for Kaldheim, a raven flies over Bretagard and sees fire giants, gathering Skelle, and a great fleet heading to the Beskir Stronghold.

citations.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

bio.text: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens toward Halvar and see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge, where Halvar stands alone.

timeline.summary: A raven flies over Bretagard, seeing fire giants, gathering Skelle, and a great fleet, to the Beskir Stronghold.
timeline.quote: the greatest fleet of the age riding the wind westward

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: From the air they see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge.
timeline.quote: from the edge of the opening thin, rotting figures dragged themselves hand over hand into the human realm

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They see Halvar alone on the bridge before a heap of destroyed draugr.
timeline.quote: Before him, on the near side of the bridge, was a mound of destroyed draugr nearly waist-high.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
timeline.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
timeline.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
timeline.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The elves of Skemfar march into view, and Tyvar leaves to stop his brother's army.
timeline.quote: the elves of Skemfar, marching to war

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Cosima leaps from the river as a dolphin and sweeps a wall of water over an undead troll and draugr.
timeline.quote: It swept over the undead Torga and a handful of draugr.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
timeline.quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth lands on the ground between them and the bridge.
timeline.quote: He beat his wings once, then settled on the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Cosima fight Varragoth; Kaya's axes wound him but he is barely slowed.
timeline.quote: The second axe, this one in Kaya's hand, drove into his knee.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
timeline.quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
timeline.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar thickens the elves' armor as demons press the line.
timeline.quote: He put his hands on the backs of their armor

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
timeline.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
timeline.quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
timeline.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
timeline.quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
timeline.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma dives into the Karfell rift, and Valkyries pour out of its own rift to attack the demons.
timeline.quote: They slammed into the demons from above, feathered wings tangling with leather membrane

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
timeline.quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
timeline.quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
timeline.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Halvar's sword light sweeps over the rift and it closes, ending the flow of draugr.
timeline.quote: Slowly, like a healing wound, the rift began to shrink and close.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Demons flee and Halvar seals the holes in the world as a child watches from the village.
timeline.quote: as the god of battle sealed up the holes in the world

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: At the crossroads, the leaders review losses and the draugr and demons that escaped.
timeline.quote: We broke the draugr lines and drove off their main body

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald announces the elves will return to Skemfar.
timeline.quote: The elves will return to Skemfar, to care for our own

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
timeline.quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth attacks the heroes on giant ravens; Kaya phases them into incorporeal form to survive the fall.
timeline.quote: Kaya managed to phase them into incorporeal form just before they hit the river below

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar goes to intercept his brother Harald; Cosima washes away an undead troll threatening Kaya.
timeline.quote: until Cosima , God of the Voyage, arrived and washed away the undead with a summoned wave.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varragoth intercepts Kaya and Cosima; Tyvar and the elven army united under Harald rescue them and let Kaya and Harald reach Halvar.
timeline.quote: the timely arrival of Tyvar and the elven army, now united under Harald

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya gives Halvar the Sword; as he begins the ritual, Koma emerges through a tear in the sky and glides into Karfell's rift, disrupting the undead flow.
timeline.quote: Kaya gave Halvar the Sword of the Realms, which he accepted solemnly.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valkyries and Niko Aris pour out of the rift; Kaya phases through Varragoth's arm and cuts his throat with an axe, killing him.
timeline.quote: She phased through the demon's arm and swung an axe clean through his throat.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Halvar completes the ritual and the Doomskar is sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts; the gods vanish; Tyvar accepts Kaya's invitation; Niko learns she cannot return to Theros.
timeline.quote: the Doomskar was sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts between realms.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varragoth and the Skelle carry out a horrific massacre, remembered in naming the winter season Bloodsky.
timeline.quote: a somber name that commemorates the horrific massacre inflicted by Varragoth and the Skelle

citation.text: "Bretagard", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurrik, founder of the Beskir, once saves the god Alrund's life.
timeline.quote: Their founder, Hurrik, once saved the god Alrund 's life.

citation.text: "Bretagard", section "The Beskir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Skelle grow into a terrible force under Varragoth's tutelage and break the Code of the Clans.
timeline.quote: They have broken the Code of the Clans and are no longer bound by it.

citation.text: "Bretagard", section "The Skelle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Inga's party engage Vorinclex in Aldergard and Alrund reveals himself.
timeline.quote: the party engaged Vorinclex

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the demon Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe.
timeline.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Niko save each other's lives in battle.
timeline.quote: Niko and Kaya ended up saving each other's lives during the battle

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar praises Kaya for killing Varragoth after the Doomskar ends.
timeline.quote: Tyvar met Kaya and praised her for killing Varragoth

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
